name: Mishima (Fukushima, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Mishima town emblem in red: a ring of concentric lines with a stylised device of horizontal bars at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Mishima, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1965.

features.role: Mishima town emblem — a ring of concentric lines with a stylised device of horizontal bars at the fly
